why: UNIVERSES: A's theorems are taken at universe 0 (.{0,0} for the Part I lemmas; the trivial-bundle witnesses have no universe parameter). Both sides add the hypothesis that |X| is paracompact, which the printed statement does not name; the project's proof and B's blind reading both take it from the partition of unity of Theorem 12.2.11. With that, theorem_12_2_13 and B have the same hypotheses up to order: reflexive 1-fibres, X tame, |X| paracompact, N reflexive over ∂X (IsReflexiveAuxNormOn). They also have the same conclusion: a reflexive auxiliary norm equal to N over ∂X. B also carries the instance [ParacompactSpace (pullbackSpace P X.src)]; A_to_B ignores it and B_to_A supplies it from StrongBundle.paracompactSpace_pullback. The remaining conjuncts are proof pieces and satisfiability witnesses that do not follow from B: theorem_12_2_13_hyp needs no tameness, the Part I local step needs no |X|, and the witnesses are concrete. They are re-proved outright by copying the project's proofs, which rest only on non-item lemmas. The two statements say the same thing.
